definitions.ask: Should one Ctrl+9 press from an unpinned daily copy also jump to the current Pomodoro on the pinned tab?
definitions.why: Keeps the existing rule that the first press opens the daily note and the second press jumps.

choices.label: Land on the pinned tab with its cursor kept; a second press jumps, as from any other note
Land on the pinned tab and jump to the current Pomodoro line in the same press

definitions.ask: Should Ctrl+9 in another note with its own Pomodoros section (e.g. yesterday's daily) go to today's daily?
definitions.why: The in-place jump is existing, tested behavior, and the bug report does not touch it.

choices.label: Keep jumping inside that note; only copies of today's daily change
Go to today's daily tab or open it; jump in place only on today's best daily tab
